title: Fuel Copying Phase
statement: Let $B,F$ be Boolean finite Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, choose Boolean parameters `forward` and `findMode`, an input word $x$, a base loop-host configuration, an input-head position $p$, a Boolean flag tape, an output word $o$, and Boolean words $r$ and $u$. For every Boolean word $v$, start the host in controller phase $2$ with counter tape storing $v$, payload tape blank on the first $|v|$ cells and otherwise equal to the buffer tape of $vr$, both heads at $|v|$, and output $o$. After exactly $|r|+1$ steps it is in phase $3$, with counter tape storing $vr$, payload tape blank, and both heads at $|vr|-1$; the remaining frame data, including the output, are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: counter tape is the buffer tape of $v$
payload is blank before $|v|$ and agrees with the buffer tape of $vr$ elsewhere
replaced:
Let $p$ be the already-copied prefix and $r$ the remaining fuel suffix. Starting the
loop host in its counter-copy phase on a controller frame whose counter track is the
buffer tape of $p$ and whose payload track is the partially cleared copying tape, with
both heads at cell $|p|$, after exactly $|r| + 1$ steps the host is in the synchronized-
rewind phase with the counter track holding the full fuel word, the payload track blank,
and both heads one cell left of the word's right end.
